items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: But anyway, you know, they got it back.
Oh, yes. What was it like working with George Avakian, because he’s still around?

George is still around, yeah. George is cool man. We’re still good friends. We’re still good friends. We talk every once in a while. Every once in a while he’ll call me or I’ll call him. We’ve been cool, you dig?
